prompt: Draw a Mermaid flowchart of a password reset: request reset, email a link, check whether the link has expired, set a new password, show a confirmation.
Draw a Mermaid sequence diagram of an online card payment between Shopper, Shop, Payment Gateway and Bank.
Draw a Mermaid class diagram for a library with Book, Member and Loan, where a member can have many loans.
Draw a Mermaid state diagram for a support ticket: New, Assigned, Waiting for customer, Resolved and Closed, where a resolved ticket can be reopened.
Draw a Mermaid entity relationship diagram for a school with Student, Course, Enrolment and Teacher.
Draw a Mermaid Gantt chart for a six-week website launch starting on 2027-01-04, with design, build, test and launch phases that depend on each other.
Draw a Mermaid timeline of a company's history: founded in 2019, first release in 2021, Series A in 2023, international launch in 2025.
Draw a Mermaid mindmap for planning a team offsite, with branches for venue, agenda, travel and budget.
Add a payment check between 'Order received' and the stock check. If the payment fails, go to a new 'Cancel order' step.
